How the suggestions were made

  • Role: keyPoints of weight 2 or more are core (scored, required for mastery); weight 1 is supporting (scored, never blocks mastery on its own). A concept with no weight-2 keyPoint has its heaviest keyPoint promoted to core. No keyPoint is suggested as extra.
  • Keyword grading (lexical: evidence): only checks that start with Names, Mentions, Gives an example or Uses the term, and whose evidence is a specific name or number that the check itself mentions. Everything else is never, so the keyword fallback returns uncertain for it.
  • Follow-ups were written per core keyPoint by Claude at authoring time. A follow-up may name the topic but must not contain an answer word: a requiredEvidence phrase that is not already in the concept's label or probe. The compiler rejects any that do.
